messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data or the ability to browse the internet, so I can’t provide a current list of movie releases. If you let me know a specific timeframe (e.g., “movies released in the last month”) or a particular genre or region, I can give you a general idea of what’s typically coming out around that time based on historical patterns.
message.reasoning: User asks "What are the latest movie releases?" We need to respond with a list of recent movies. But we have no browsing capability. We can provide general info or ask clarifying question. According to policy, we cannot hallucinate. So we should ask for clarification or say we don't have up-to-date info. We can offer to search but we can't. So best to ask user for more context or specify that we don't have real-time data.
